import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
    if not data:
        return
    N, M, L, R = map(int, data[:4])
    MOD = 998244353
    inv2 = (MOD + 1) // 2  # modular inverse of 2 mod MOD
    total = N * M
    colors = R - L + 1
    p = pow(colors, total, MOD)
    if total % 2 == 1:
        ans = p
    elif colors % 2 == 0:
        ans = (p * inv2) % MOD
    else:
        ans = ((p + 1) * inv2) % MOD
    print(ans)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
